In the separately documented source compatibility profile, slides are fixed 1920×1080, direct children of a slide row and not resizable, rotatable or transformable; these are source restrictions, not global restrictions on native Layout frames. Preserve any clone-parent/hierarchy conflict as typed unsupported until an original-runtime fixture resolves it. Author/select/reorder/copy/skip, undo and inspect use the shared command, Controls, Argus and manual surfaces; source-profile incompatibility must be visible.
